page.layout: One printed page, text only: title block at top in large capitals, a subtitle block, a centred heading "ORDINES HI SVNT.", then two numbered series of lines (I and II with sub-items 1–5) set left of centre. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: MARINA, ITA HIC QVAE IN DVLCIBVS AQVIS
I. DE Piscibus fluuiatilibus: Cuius Partes sunt 5.
5. De Piscibus anadromis, id est, e mari subeuntibus amnes.
II. DE reliquis in dulcibus aquis animalibus: Cuius Partes sunt 4.

page.notes: The roman numerals of the first series are printed as "I." and "II."; the sub-item numbers are printed as 1–5 in old-style figures. Marks such as "Pifciculis"/"Piscciculis" are printed as they appear; the first is read as "Piscículis" with the printed spelling kept as best read. The numbers 5 and 4 at the end of the series headings are printed in a larger, old-style form. Some letters in the title block are blurred by the scan; the title words are copied as legible. Ornaments and stray dots are ignored.
